 Job Scan Home / GST / Two-Year Limitation u/s 54 of CGST Act does not Apply to Refund of Service Tax Appeal Pre-Deposit: GSTAT [Read Order] GST Law Report Two-Year Limitation u/s 54 of CGST Act does not Apply to Refund of Service Tax Appeal Pre-Deposit: GSTAT [Read Order]
 Pro Assessee · More rulings on Refund → · Demand and recovery → 
 A service tax appeal pre-deposit mistakenly paid through GST Form DRC-03 is not governed by the two-year refund limitation under Section 54 of the CGST Act.
 By  Kavi Priya · 10 Nov 2026, 5:07 pm IST 2′ read Save Get the day's tax rulings in your inbox 
 Email address Subscribe × The Kolkata Bench of the Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) held that the two-year limitation period under Section 54 of the CGST Act, 2017 does not apply to the refund of a service tax appeal pre-deposit mistakenly made through GST Form DRC-03. 
 Jhawar Suppliers (the respondent) had challenged a service tax demand of Rs. 14,73,456 relating to financial year 2015-16. Under Section 35F of the Central Excise Act, 1944, the taxpayer was required to make a mandatory pre-deposit for filing the appeal.
 Headnote The case number, coram and counsel for this order are part of the subscriber record.
